# Render Over Fly.io

**Decision (2026-07-24, round 11):** host the [[stickfps]] game server on Render. Koyeb recorded as
an equal alternative; Fly.io demoted to "needs a card".

This is the same question answered twice, oppositely, in one project — which is what makes it worth a
page.

## Round 1: Render evaluated and rejected

> "Evaluated Render as a Fly.io/Vercel replacement; rejected after confirming (web search) Render has
> no public inbound UDP — kept Fly.io (backend) + Vercel (frontend, user's existing account)."
> — browser_game_stickfps/PROGRESS.md, 2026-07-25

Correct at the time. The transport was geckos.io over UDP, and a host with no inbound UDP cannot
serve it at all. Fly.io was never chosen on its merits — it was **forced by the transport**.

## Round 11: the constraint was removed instead of satisfied

When the requirement became "host this without a credit card", the binding constraint was UDP, not
the host. [[websocket-tcp-over-geckos-udp]] deleted the UDP requirement, and Render's
disqualification went with it. Every managed UDP host wanted a card; every free no-card tier spoke
TCP.

**The transferable move:** when no option satisfies a constraint acceptably, check whether the
constraint is load-bearing before accepting the least-bad option. Here one layer of the stack was
cheaper to change than the entire hosting decision it was dictating.

## What Render was chosen on

Free tier with no card, persistent process (required for a 60 Hz authoritative loop — see
[[split-frontend-backend-hosting]]), WebSocket upgrades on the standard port, and a `/healthz` route
for its health check. Accepted cost: free instances idle down after ~15 minutes and cold-start the
next player. Details on [[render-hosting]].

## Configured, not codified

Render is set up through dashboard settings — Root Directory `server`, build
`npm install && npm run build`, start `npm start` — with **no `render.yaml`, no CI and no
`.github/`** in the repository. `fly.toml` and a working [[docker]] image remain in the tree for the
abandoned path.
